$comment: Ids of the KV namespaces deploy/resources.mjs created, by title, and of the Rate Limiting namespaces it allocated (D70), by `<deployed worker>/<binding>`. Ids are not secret. resources.mjs looks every KV namespace up by title on each run, and reads the Rate Limiting ids the account's scripts bind (read only), and rewrites this file, so the account, not this file, is the source of truth.
